components.component: Treasury, program upgrade authorities, pool authority key
components.quantum_threat: Shor: key recovery from exposed pubkey → theft / malicious upgrade
components.harvest_now: no (live forgery once a CRQC exists)
components.defense: Move cold treasury and upgrade authorities behind a reviewed hash-based (Winternitz) or Falcon-verified vault whose own upgrade authority is PQ-controlled or revoked; keep hot balances small.
components.migration_trigger: CRQC estimate moves inside 5 years; SIMD for PQ account types; SIMD-0579 activation

components.quantum_threat: Shor: payer key forgery → unauthorized payments

components.quantum_threat: Shor: discrete logs on the setup elements recover the trapdoor → forged withdraw proofs → pool drain. Past proofs stay private (Groth16 is zero-knowledge for unbounded adversaries).
components.harvest_now: no for soundness; no privacy leak from proofs
components.defense: Plan a hash-based proof system (STARK/FRI, as in Anza's Plonky3 prototype) for v2; keep a pause/upgrade path held by a PQ-safe authority; cap pool exposure.
components.migration_trigger: Any credible ECDLP progress on ~256-bit curves

components.quantum_threat: Grover/BHT only: generic quantum speedups reduce, but do not break, preimage and collision security
